notes.title: PROVIDER Update 1.0.0.8
notes.content:
Minor update, mostly small fixes

[list]
[*]Fixed some speling mistakes
[*] Added  "Skip to End" prompt during speech
[*] Fixed Father Allbridge saying lines over and over
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.0.7
notes.content:
Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed "Home" NPC's sometimes crashing 
[*] Fixed players sometimes getting stuck on walls/trees (Immediately returns you to the last free place you were in)
[*] Fixed final boss melee-damage range
[/list]

Thanks for all the feedback y'all have been sending us! (Though I have been having a minor panic attack every time I heard my notification ding, so there's that)

notes.title: Panic Update 1.0.0.6
notes.content:
We've already had lots of bug reports and ux issues

[list]
[*] Fixed end-game boss collider not always hitting
[*] Fixed players getting stuck on M-ENG Growers 
[*] Fixed endcard sound issue
[*] Fixed Abigail being killable before final encounter.
[*] Fixed main menu interactions when in windowed mode
[*] Fixed main menu locking certain players into certain control schemes.
[/list]

This wraps up most of the major issues we've seen day 1. Please keep reporting bugs if you see 'em!

notes.title: PANIC UPDATE (1.0.0.2)
notes.content:
Launch day is here!! Unfortunately, that means some issues were immediately found. Fortunately, it means they're now fixed!!

The changes are as follows
[list]
[*] Fixed Father Allbridge not spawning
[*] Fixed boss-doors not locking properly in Hospital
[*] Slightly increased Bugglin run speed
[*] Slightly increased Fiend run speed
[*] Slightly decreased Wolverdog life pool
[*] Fixed a wall collider issue
[*] Fixed some typos
[*] Fixed Home NPC's array access issue
[/list]

Thanks for playing!
